parsed.reason: The message owns the failure clearly ("That one broke on my end") without naming a technical cause, and states plainly that nothing was changed. It uses first-person language and simple words in the voice of a competent friend. It contains no question mark, no digit, no apology words, no incident language, no grovelling, no greeting or emoji, and no contradiction. It tells the parent exactly what happened without handing them an errand or claiming part went through. This is the intended form.
